fact: On 26-27 January 2026 ARMP with PAFEN held a workshop presenting the e-GP strategy and roadmap; the existing state portal is being upgraded while the sector prepares for a full end-to-end e-GP system, and a draft e-procurement decree goes to the Council of Ministers.
title: Présentation de la stratégie et de la feuille de route e-GP
publisher: ARMP, Journal Officiel des Marchés Publics
